sentences.text: This matter is taken up through hybrid mode.

01.
2. Mr. A. Mohanty, learned Counsel appearing for the Petitioners states that he may be permitted to implead Collector, Angul as opposite party no.7 to the writ petition in Court itself, as he is a necessary party to the writ petition.
3. On oral prayer being made by Mr. A. Mohanty, learned Counsel appearing for the Petitioners, he is permitted to implead Collector, Angul as opposite party no.7 to the writ petition.

4. Heard Mr. A. Mohanty, learned Counsel appearing for the Petitioners and learned Addl.
Government Advocate appearing for the State-Opposite Parties.
5.

The Petitioners have filed this Writ Petition seeking direction to the opposite parties to confer all the resettlement benefits upon the petitioners including the building assistance fee, transportation fee and other ancillary fees after deducting the plot fee of Rs.6 lakhs in accordance with the provisions of Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition, Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013.

entities.text: Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition, Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013
entities.label: STATUTE

sentences.text: 6. In course of hearing, learned Counsel for the Petitioner states that the Petitioners have already made representation before the Opposite Party no.7-Collector, Angul vide Annexure-4, and the same may be directed to be disposed of within a stipulated time, to which learned State Counsel has raised no objection.

7. As agreed by learned counsel for the parties and after going through the records, this Court,
